summary: Local service-request coverage reconciliation, selected public option labels in WhatsApp enquiry drafts, and dashboard Catalog Product Share. No deployment/publication/provider effects.
noAssistantImpact: Product Share is an explicit browser share/copy action over a protected read of an already public product. It grants no publishing authority and is intentionally form-only. Public customer enquiry selection is not a model tool. Existing assistant capabilities and confirmation rules are unchanged.

procedures.reason: Dashboard Product Share dialog only. Authenticated Catalog readers in the current authorized Store may read an existing public product link; no publish, unpublish, consent, entitlement, provider or model authority.

docs.note: Classifies the new catalog.productShare procedure as form-only; no model capability or publishing authority.

evidence.result: Injected current-source, runtime and read-scope checks pass without DB/provider calls.
Actual public loader reuses published Store and plan cap; QA, unpublished and foreign Store cases refuse with an injected repository.
Current option label/order/encoding and unknown/duplicate option refusal pass offline.
